args.text:
pass^k means the agent has to succeed on all k attempts, not just one of them. So if k=3, pass^3 only counts as a success if run 1, run 2, and run 3 all succeed. That makes it a stricter reliability measure than pass@3, which counts success if any one of the 3 runs works.
